id: \bSpenser: Welcome child. My name is Spenser, and I will be your opponent.
en: \bSpenser: Welcome child. My name is Spenser, and I will be your opponent.
it: \bSpenser: Benvenuto, ragazzo. Il mio nome è Spenser, e sarò il tuo avversario.

id: \bI'm sure you're used to battling inside. Well here we battle in nature alonside our Pokémon.
en: \bI'm sure you're used to battling inside. Well here we battle in nature alonside our Pokémon.
it: \bSarai abituato a lottare al chiuso. Beh, qui si lotta nella natura, al fianco dei propri Pokémon.

id: \bYoung one of a Trainer! Do you believe in your Pokémon?
en: \bYoung one of a Trainer! Do you believe in your Pokémon?

it: \bSpenser: Ti sei guadagnato il Simbolo Spirito.

id: \bI suggest the next place you go to is the Battle Tower. It's located west of Viridian City, near the Indigo League.
en: \bI suggest the next place you go to is the Battle Tower. It's located west of Viridian City, near the Indigo League.
it: \bTi consiglio di andare alla Torre Lotta come prossima tappa. Si trova a ovest di Smeraldopoli, vicino alla Lega Indigo.
